news.story: This was Poole's fourth consecutive game with five dimes, and he finished with a season high in points and three-pointers made. He's been heating up over this four-game stretch with averages of 15.0 points, 5.0 assists and 1.8 triples per contest.

news.headline: Poole finished Saturday's 116-108 loss to the Nuggets with 14 points (3-7 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 7-7 FT), two rebounds and five assists in 24 minutes.
news.story: Poole scored at least 13 points for the third straight game, and he is seemingly now a consistent part of the rotation in New Orleans. While managers are well within their rights to be skeptical, Poole is all of a sudden back on the radar, even in standard leagues. With that said, his overall upside is limited, particularly if he is playing no more than about 25 minutes per night.

news.headline: Poole finished with 14 points (5-8 FG, 2-3 3Pt, 2-4 FT), an assist and a block across 21 minutes in Wednesday's 145-111 loss to the Nets.
news.story: Poole made efficient use of his limited offensive opportunities, but his 21-minute workload and minimal secondary contributions limited his fantasy production. Poole's scoring ability provides occasional upside, but his inconsistent playing time and narrow statistical profile outside of the scoring column make him difficult to trust in standard formats.

news.story: Friday's game was the perfect example of why Giddey's fantasy value doesn't depend on prolific scoring. His ability to fill the stat sheet can't be overlooked, and his three blocks added an unexpected defensive bonus. The triple-double also helped the Bulls snap an eight-game losing streak. Giddey's free-throw shooting remains a weakness, but his contributions in multiple categories make him particularly valuable…
